analysis_population.events: only archived historically-absent spp.name x holmkod rows belonging to v1.174.2 exact-source species
analysis_population.target_partition: frozen v1.172 target-island spatial block assignment
analysis_population.pilot_rows: eligible events whose target island is in a frozen pilot block
analysis_population.confirmatory_rows: eligible events whose target island is in a frozen confirmatory block

response_independent_preprocessing.surface: all frozen eligible pilot plus confirmatory event rows; predictors only, before any future outcome access
response_independent_preprocessing.numeric_missing: replace missing/nonfinite value by the population median of available values for that predictor over the complete frozen eligible predictor surface; append a binary missingness indicator when any missing value exists
response_independent_preprocessing.numeric_zero_variance: drop the predictor response-independently if its post-imputation population variance is exactly zero
response_independent_preprocessing.numeric_standardization: population mean zero and population SD one over the complete frozen eligible predictor surface after imputation; missingness indicators are not standardized
response_independent_preprocessing.categorical_levels: freeze all levels from the complete frozen eligible predictor surface, lexicographically sorted after Unicode NFC plus trim
response_independent_preprocessing.categorical_encoding: full one-hot levels, all coefficients ridge-penalized; no outcome-based collapsing or reference-level selection

source_features.euclidean_nearest: minimum EUREF Euclidean km from historically absent target island to exact occupied source set
source_features.euclidean_pressure: sum exp(-euclidean_km / frozen actual-graph kernel_scale_km) over exact occupied sources
source_features.actual_graph_nearest: minimum shortest-path km on frozen actual v1.172 graph to exact occupied source set
source_features.actual_graph_pressure: sum exp(-actual_graph_shortest_path_km / frozen actual-graph kernel_scale_km) over exact occupied sources
source_features.null_graph_features: same two C features recomputed separately on each of the 20 exact frozen v1.172 null graphs using the same actual-graph kernel scale
source_features.R2_context_invariant: actual-graph generic node context only; identical in R3, actual C and all 20 null C models

model_family.nesting: each model contains all features of the preceding reference; every C model adds exactly two topology-specific source features to the identical R3 design
model_family.solver: deterministic IRLS with pivoted Gaussian elimination

pilot_access.allowed_outcome_values: only frozen eligible event keys in pilot spatial blocks
purpose: freeze every confirmatory prediction probability before confirmatory outcome access
pilot_access.gate_failure: terminal non-estimable; no block, species, feature, penalty or threshold changes

confirmatory_access.allowed_outcome_values: only exact frozen confirmatory prediction row keys

confirmatory_primary.block_aggregation: within each frozen confirmatory spatial block, average event-level loss contrast; then give each presence-bearing block equal weight
confirmatory_primary.favourable_direction: negative for both P1 and P2
confirmatory_primary.support_rule: P1 < 0 and P1 95% block-bootstrap upper bound < 0 AND P2 < 0 and P2 95% block-bootstrap upper bound < 0

mechanistic_secondary.predeclared_S: S_i_n from frozen v1.172 response-independent finite-source sensitivity
mechanistic_secondary.median_split: high versus low using the median frozen over all confirmatory prediction rows before outcome access
mechanistic_secondary.contrast: equal-block mean P2_event in high-S minus equal-block mean P2_event in low-S; predicted negative
mechanistic_secondary.continuous_check: weighted slope of P2_event on z(log1p(S_i_n)) among successful confirmatory events, equal-block weighting; predicted negative

guardrails.all_event_P1: equal-block mean logloss(C_actual)-logloss(R3) over all confirmatory events
guardrails.failure_event_P1: equal-block mean logloss(C_actual,y=0)-logloss(R3,y=0) over confirmatory failures
guardrails.all_event_P2: equal-block mean logloss(C_actual)-mean null-C loss over all confirmatory events
guardrails.may_invalidate_interpretation_if_extreme: discussion-level interpretation boundary only; no post hoc numerical threshold

claim_boundary.positive_primary_can_support: in this independent archipelago and temporal endpoint, exact historical source topology contains future colonization information beyond source count, direct Euclidean source proximity/pressure, recipient-island state, species traits and generic graph context
claim_boundary.positive_secondary_can_support: topology-specific colonization information is concentrated where response-free finite-source configuration sensitivity is higher

anti_selection: no re-entry of the 275 nonnumeric species
no outcome-based feature removal or complete-case filter
no use of published AIC-selected final model as Structural reference
no graph k, kernel, null, block, S threshold or ridge tuning from pilot or confirmatory outcome
no change to P1/P2 support rule after pilot
